reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "`frontend.forward-headers-list` CLI flag and its corresponding YAML setting are removed", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: Any frontend.forward-headers-list CLI flag or YAML configuration will no longer be honoured and must be removed before upgrade.

proposed.statement: The frontend.forward-headers-list CLI flag and its corresponding YAML setting are removed in Loki 3.0.0.
